statements.status_notes: The DHI util-linux package backports the upstream libblkid nested partition probing use-after-free fix from https://github.com/util-linux/util-linux/commit/132d9c8aa15a8efd0a23d8ca7ed8b98f365e84fa as dhi-cve-2026-13595-libblkid-partitions-uaf-backport.patch.

The DHI util-linux package backports the upstream libblkid nested partition probing use-after-free fix from https://github.com/util-linux/util-linux/commit/132d9c8aa15a8efd0a23d8ca7ed8b98f365e84fa as dhi-cve-2026-13595-libblkid-partitions-uaf-backport.patch.

Affected code in setpwnam() is only used by chsh and chfn which are not build in any Debian released binary package from src:util-linux and explicitly configured as with --disable-chfn-chsh since 2.25-1.
Package util-linux in Debian does build with readline support but chfn and chsh are provided by src:shadow and util-linux is configured with --disable-chfn-chsh.

The DHI util-linux package backports the upstream libblkid DOS partition 64-bit bounds and overflow guards (util-linux v2.42.2) from https://github.com/util-linux/util-linux/security/advisories/GHSA-h4rw-gv36-wmp5 as dhi-cve-2026-53612-53613-53614-53615-libmount-libblkid-backport.patch.

The DHI util-linux package backports the upstream libmount SUID hardening that reads LIBMOUNT_FORCE_MOUNT2 via safe_getenv and refuses multi-step legacy mount(2) sequences for restricted users from https://github.com/util-linux/util-linux/commit/31e37c1c7dcf25b76ccf41391fe934a75644c661 as dhi-cve-2026-53612-53613-53614-53615-libmount-libblkid-backport.patch.

The DHI util-linux package backports the upstream libmount TOCTOU fix that pins the mount target with an O_PATH fd (openat2 RESOLVE_NO_SYMLINKS) before mounting from https://github.com/util-linux/util-linux/commit/0d3d55975aa3492c62fd345eac38f41cd166c0b0 as dhi-cve-2026-53612-53613-53614-53615-libmount-libblkid-backport.patch.

The DHI util-linux package backports the upstream libmount fd-based ownership/mode hook fix (fchownat/chmod via a pinned target fd) from https://github.com/util-linux/util-linux/commit/d0c5adaeb3a3d823aba1377794de8f009b8152cc as dhi-cve-2026-53612-53613-53614-53615-libmount-libblkid-backport.patch.
